name: p0_ram_stream
purpose: Measure fixed-work sequential LSU/fabric/data-BRAM transfer throughput and energy per KiB.

target.clock_status: ROUTED PASS: WNS +0.003 ns, TNS 0.000 ns, TIMER_TICK_CYCLES=1

measurement.warmup_end: Source/destination arrays and canaries initialized; START immediately before stream kernel
measurement.work_unit: KiB of logical load-plus-store data transfer

oracle.pass: Checksum 0x58873A00, all final destination words and canaries, then committed tohost=1
oracle.failure: Distinct error code, timeout, missing/duplicate marker, or unexpected trap/tohost

kpis.evidence: PASS: SoC and power-TB regressions; run1 SAIF capture
PASS: 32x256 volatile lw/sw pairs in fixed kernel, 65536 logical bytes
PASS: WNS +0.003 ns, TNS 0, DRC 0 Error/Critical Warning
PASS: direct 483/8762 (5.512%); reviewed 10/10 block alternative with DSP bridge
PASS: run1/run2 both 0.129 W dynamic, 0.0% difference
